detailed_feedback.safe_t_assessment: INCOMPLETE - Depression MCQs lack systematic SAFE-T evaluation. PSY-DEP-20260125-345 mentions 'denies suicidal ideation' but does not assess: (S) specific plan, (A) access to means, (F) feelings of hopelessness, (E) earlier attempts, (T) threat level. This is a critical omission given depression is highest suicide risk diagnosis.
detailed_feedback.mental_health_act_compliance: ADEQUATE - NSW MHA criteria correctly stated in PSY-SUICIDE-MHA-20260125-967, but state not specified in several MCQs. Victorian/Queensland MHA differences not addressed. Emergency detention procedures correct.
detailed_feedback.medication_safety: GOOD - Australian drug names used correctly (sertraline, olanzapine, quetiapine). Clozapine monitoring accurate. Minor omission: CPMS (Clozapine Patient Monitoring Service) not mentioned. NMS management incomplete (bromocriptine mentioned, dantrolene omitted).
detailed_feedback.cultural_safety: POOR - Zero Aboriginal/TSI considerations in 100 MCQs. No SEWB framework. No historical trauma context. No Aboriginal liaison mentioned. This violates Australian medical education standards (minimum 10% Indigenous health content).
detailed_feedback.rag_citation_quality: FAIL - All references show 'Unknown' title with no qdrant_point_id despite having rag_confidence scores. This violates constraint 11 (RAG citation requirements). Citations are non-traceable and potentially hallucinated.
detailed_feedback.template_mcq_quality: POOR - MCQs ID 2000-2064 are low-quality template generations with: (1) Empty key_points arrays, (2) Repetitive scenarios, (3) Formulaic stems, (4) Incomplete explanations. These should be removed or regenerated.
detailed_feedback.clinical_realism: MODERATE - Scenarios are clinically plausible but lack complexity. Real AMC cases involve: (1) Multi-morbidity, (2) Medication interactions, (3) Socioeconomic factors, (4) Cultural considerations. Current MCQs are single-diagnosis focused.
detailed_feedback.explanation_quality: POOR - 'why_incorrect' fields incomplete. Example from PSY-DEP-20260125-345: 'Incorrect - Adjustment disorder with depressed mood' without explaining WHY (e.g., 'Adjustment disorder requires identifiable stressor within 3 months, duration <6 months'). This reduces educational value.

critical_issues: SAFETY: Depression MCQs do not systematically assess suicide risk - potential patient safety issue
COMPLIANCE: Zero Indigenous health content violates Australian medical education standards
QUALITY: 64 template-generated MCQs (64% of dataset) are repetitive and low-quality
VALIDITY: All references non-traceable (no qdrant_point_id) - potential hallucinations
agent_evaluations.recommendation: CONDITIONAL_PASS pending: (1) Add SAFE-T assessment to all depression MCQs, (2) Remove template MCQs ID 2000-2064, (3) Add Aboriginal/TSI content (10 MCQs minimum), (4) Fix RAG citations or remove qdrant references. Current state acceptable for pilot testing but NOT for production deployment.
